name: Free Online Image Upscaler (GPU Accelerated / RealCUGAN) - ATools
description: Free online image upscaler with 2×/3× enlargement. Uses WebGPU / WebGL 2 Shader hardware acceleration by default, with RealCUGAN AI and high-quality resize fallbacks.
seoDescription: Free online image upscaler powered by pure WebGPU / WebGL 2 Shaders (EASU + RCAS) and RealCUGAN. Upscale anime, illustrations, and photos by 2× or 3× in milliseconds locally in your browser without uploads or massive model downloads. Private and blazing fast.

ui.hint: Image upscaler: uses GPU Shader acceleration by default (supports WebGPU / WebGL 2, millisecond speeds, zero model downloads, 100% private & client-side). RealCUGAN AI and compatible resize modes are also supported.
ui.dropReplaceHint: Drag and drop a new image here to replace directly
ui.gpuUnsupported: GPU acceleration is not enabled in this browser. Switched to fallback mode automatically.
ui.modelLoadingHint: Loading RealCUGAN model weights and runtime (~12MB), please wait a few seconds…
ui.notReadyDesc: The runtime is still loading. Please try again shortly.
ui.crossOriginIsolatedDesc: RealCUGAN (threads) requires SharedArrayBuffer. Open under Cross-Origin Isolation (set COOP/COEP response headers). Otherwise switch to “GPU Fast Upscale” or “High-quality resize”.
ui.unsupportedDesc: Use the latest Chrome/Firefox. If you cannot enable Cross-Origin Isolation, switch to “GPU Fast Upscale” or “High-quality resize”.
ui.noteBody: GPU acceleration is recommended: runs in milliseconds via your local graphics hardware (WebGPU / WebGL 2) without downloading multi-megabyte models. Completely private and client-side.
